card.name: Words starting with acqu-
card.fires_on: The word piece "acqu" and the pieces that follow it in words like acquit, acquittal, acquitted, acquiesce and acquaint. It is strongest in legal or verdict settings.

modes.label: Acquit words
modes.description: Acquitting, acquittal or acquitted in accounts of trials and verdicts.
modes.example: The owners of the Triangle Shirtwaist Company were tried for manslaughter but<< acquitted>>.

modes.label: Acquaint words
modes.description: Acquainted or acquaintance, meaning getting to know someone or something.
modes.example: Bologna, they became<< acquainted>> with Padre Giambattista Mart

card.writes: It promotes odd word endings and pieces, so there is no clear link to what comes next.
card.plain: It lights up on words that begin with "acqu", mostly acquitted and acquainted.
